name: EduInsights
description:
EduInsights gives Claude read-only access to public data about US colleges, programs, careers, workforce outcomes, accreditation, and observed AI use.

Compare colleges, fields of study, and careers. Explore completions, earnings, debt, employment, pay, outlook, occupational tasks, and observed AI use.

Research results include source and date details. Records preserve privacy suppression and broader field-level scope where those limits apply.

OAuth sign-in is required before using the connector. All tools remain read-only after sign-in.

_published_faq.name: How do I add EduInsights to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add EduInsights to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.eduinsights.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the EduInsights MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: EduInsights provides these MCP tools: edu_aggregate, edu_compare, edu_describe_data, edu_get_institution, edu_get_occupation, edu_get_program, edu_get_sources, edu_resolve_entity, and edu_run_sql.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to EduInsights?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to EduInsights in education on the Manufact MCP catalog include DocCheck Flexikon, Vocaneo, Grammaropolis, TheWholeTorah, and Fryd - Your Gardening Companion.
EduInsights requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
EduInsights is developed by AI Idea Lab. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
